editorial.blurb: This intimate Gold Coast omakase spot delivers masterful sushi crafted by a chef with 25+ years of experience, paired with genuinely warm hospitality that makes every visit feel celebratory.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for the omakase experience (12 or 17-course options) where each piece is made to order and handed to you—it's one of Chicago's more affordable omakase options, and pair it with a sake flight ($44) rather than cocktails for the best complement to the fish.
